texts.preamble: Lakkireddy Venkata Subba Reddy A vs State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 November, 2019 Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu Criminal Petition No.6557 of 2019 Order:
texts.facts: This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the order dated 13.09.2019 against the petitioner, in Crl.M.P.No.1472 of 2019 in CC No.146 of 2015 on the file of V Additional Munsif Magistrate, Guntur.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that offence under which the petitioner is charged under Section 59 (1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is punishable with fine only. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the lower court rejected the application on the ground of ill health of the petitioner is not bonafide and that the signature of the petitioner is also not present in the petition. He further submits that as the offence punishable under this petition is not of a serious nature, application of the petitioner can be considered on its own merits.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that offence under which the petitioner is charged under Section 59 (1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is punishable with fine only.
